items.content_html:
In home-manager we dont want to add "--set packpatk/rtp" otherwise packages are loaded twice see:
nix-community/home-manager#5964

Since the wrapper args are easily added by the user (by using finalAttrs.packpathDirs), I propose we dont set them when wrapRc is set as well.
It's a breaking change for anyone using wrapRc.

items.content_html:
A (hopefully calmer) redo of #383645

In this implementation, a configuration file is passed to Ghostty directly as opposed to settings being converted to full CLI arguments. The main advantages of this are

  1. generated configurations are easier to digest
  2. shell quoting issues are avoided
  3. options from the user (default) configuration file are still respected

As a bonus, the configuration file format is now available in passthru for use in both this new module and home-manager

items.content_html:
Changed the service to use DynamicUser and systemd credentials, and added the ability to load cert.pem files, to avoid having to place the file manually.

I also added assertions in case the certificate file is not provided and tunnels were set, which might break configs, but they would have been wrong anyway.

I tried creating a NixOS test, but I found no way to make it work in any reasonable way, since it would never be able to connect to the cloudflare backend without a private key. I tested it locally with my config and it's working, though.

This is my first contribution to Nixpkgs, and more generally to the Nix world! 🤩

so I added an option to allow customizing it, while maintaining the same behavior for existing users.

Since it is my first contribution please tell me what I can improve 😉

Like is there anything to add to release notes/docs? If yes, where?
